name: Sonic The Hedgehog for M5StickC Plus2
author: GalaxyShad (original), coreymillia + GitHub Copilot CLI (port)
description: Play Sonic the Hedgehog Green Hill Zone Act 1 on M5StickC Plus2 with Mini Joy C hat. Now with DOWN-TO-ROLL mechanic! Press down while moving to roll, release to stand up - just like the original game!
features: 🦔 Sonic The Hedgehog - Green Hill Zone Act 1
🎮 Full analog joystick support with Mini Joy C
🆕 DOWN-TO-ROLL mechanic - Press down to roll, release to stand!
⚡ Authentic Sonic physics from original Physics Guide
🎨 Custom palette-based renderer optimized for ESP32
💨 All classic moves: run, jump, roll, spindash
🔊 Silent mode (no audio to save resources)

controls.Down: Roll into ball while moving (NEW!) - Release to stand up
controls.Spindash: Hold BtnA + Joy Button while standing
controls.Roll_Alt: Hold BtnA + Joy Button while moving

usage_instructions: 1. Connect Mini Joy C hat to M5StickC Plus2 (Grove port)
2. Flash firmware using M5Burner with MERGED.bin
3. Power on - will show 'M5Stick Sonic' splash
6. Use joystick to move Sonic left/right
7. Press DOWN while moving to roll into ball
8. Release DOWN to stand back up
10. Hold BtnA + Joy Button for spindash (standing) or roll (moving)
11. Collect rings and reach the end!

technical_details.physics_engine: Based on Sonic Retro Physics Guide
technical_details.input_thresholds: Left Y>3000, Right Y<1600, Down X<1200
technical_details.roll_mechanic: Down press triggers ACT_ROLL, release returns to ACT_NORMAL

version_history.1.2.0: Added DOWN-TO-ROLL mechanic: Press down while moving to roll, release to stand up. Just like original Sonic!
version_history.1.1.0: Increased screen size to 211x119, optimized rendering, fixed joystick axes
version_history.1.0.0: Initial M5StickC Plus2 port: Mini Joy C support, removed FPS overlay, fixed controls
